Plot an mpcurve model fit

Source: R/07_mpcurve.R
plot.mpcurve.Rd

Visualise an mpcurve fit. Pseudotime is mapped to \([0,1]\), with grid component \(k\) at \((k-1)/(K-1)\). For a responsibility row \(\gamma_i\), the posterior-mean pseudotime is $$t_i = \sum_{k=1}^{K} \gamma_{ik} \cdot \frac{k-1}{K-1}.$$

For a fixed-M structural partition fit, scatterplots contain one panel per ordering. Panel \(m\) uses that ordering's \(q(C^{(m)})\) responsibilities for pseudotime and overlays the conditional trajectory mean from \(q(U_j\mid Z_j=m)\). The fitted feature-assignment probabilities for the selected dimensions are shown in each panel title.

"scatterplot"

Scatter of two chosen dimensions, colored by pseudotime, with posterior means overlaid as an orange path. For a structural partition fit, draws one panel per fixed ordering.

"elbo"

For a single-ordering fit, delegates to the underlying CAVI trace plot. For a structural partition fit, plots the single fixed-M structural objective history. Values recorded at different annealing temperatures are not directly comparable; the exact \(T=1\) segment is the monotonicity diagnostic.

"mu"

Posterior-mean trajectory only. With one selected dimension, plots the feature mean against normalized latent position; with two dimensions, plots the posterior-mean path in that feature plane. Structural partition fits draw one panel per ordering directly from the canonical $conditional_posterior$mean, representing \(E[U_j\mid Z_j=m]\); derived $fits are not the data source.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mpcurve'
plot(
  x,
  plot_type = c("scatterplot", "elbo", "mu"),
  dims = c(1L, 2L),
  data = NULL,
  pal = (grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#0000FF", "#00FFFF", "#00FF00", "#FFFF00",
    "#FF0000")))(256L),
  add_legend = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

An mpcurve object.

plot_type

One of "scatterplot" (default), "elbo", "mu".

dims

Integer vector of length one or two identifying feature columns. It determines the scatterplot axes and the trajectory coordinates used by plot_type = "mu". Defaults to c(1, 2).

data

Optional numeric n x d matrix used by scatterplots. If NULL, data stored on x are used. It is not required for plot_type = "elbo" or plot_type = "mu".

pal

Colour palette (length-256 character vector) used to map pseudotime to point colours. Defaults to the classic pseudotime rainbow (navy \(\to\) cyan \(\to\) green \(\to\) gold \(\to\) red), which avoids white and is easy to read against a white background.

add_legend

Logical; draw a gradient color-bar legend? Default TRUE.

...

Additional base-graphics arguments. For single-ordering non-scatter plots these are forwarded to the underlying CAVI plot method.

Value

Invisibly returns x.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sim <- simulate_dual_trajectory(n = 100, d1 = 3, d2 = 3, seed = 1)
fit <- fit_mpcurve(
  sim$X,
  intrinsic_dim = 2,
  K = 8,
  n_outer = 3,
  max_converge_iter = 3
)
plot(fit, plot_type = "scatterplot", dims = c(1, 4))
plot(fit, plot_type = "mu", dims = 1)
plot(fit, plot_type = "mu", dims = c(1, 4))
plot(fit, plot_type = "elbo")
} # }
